# Website Content Governance Audit

## Purpose
Reviews website content ownership, lifecycle, consistency, and maintenance controls.

## Workflow
1. Define site sections and content types.
2. Review approved content inventories, publishing roles, review dates, templates, metadata, localization variants, and archival rules.
3. Identify stale, duplicate, ownerless, or inconsistent content using evidence and explicit thresholds.
4. Recommend governance roles, review cadence, and measurable quality checks.
5. Separate editorial recommendations from SEO hypotheses.

## Output
Content inventory fields, governance gap register, lifecycle policy outline, and prioritized cleanup backlog.

## Safety and limits
- Do not delete, rewrite, or publish content. Do not infer factual accuracy from age alone. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
